clauses: Canonical source fingerprints normalize relative paths to POSIX separators.
Canonical source fingerprint file ordering is platform-independent.
CI, pre-freeze qualification and full certification share the canonical fingerprint utility.
Windows and macOS G14 must verify one exact source fingerprint from one exact source ZIP.
macOS native audit invocation must not depend on upload-preserved executable metadata.
Smart Router v2 and Rapid Move runtime behavior are inherited unchanged.
Protected deterministic Day/Swing/Long formulas remain unchanged.
v17.5.1 Stable remains isolated and untouched.
